notes: Regression fixes for v0.5.9: the cart eye/pen buttons now work (handlers were missing), changing a password really requires the current one (with TITAOU as the recovery master key), the user pin button functions, and ALL timestamps — including existing records — now display in local time via a one-time migration of legacy UTC-stored rows. Employee absences and advances persist correctly (their records were dated in UTC, landing on the wrong day and being skipped by the month filter). Clearing sales/purchase history gets a 10-second cancel countdown. The cart customer/supplier dropdowns have search boxes. The purchase-mode estimated sale price is computed from the entered sale prices with the expected profit (cost 30, sale 60, qty 10 = 600 DZD estimated sale + 300 DZD profit), and POS purchase checkouts now move the drawer cash (supplier payment booked as a cash movement).
